items.prompt: What is the order of rotational symmetry of an equilateral triangle?
hints: It looks the same after a third of a turn.
There are three matching positions.
Count the corners.
items.explanation: An equilateral triangle matches itself 3 times in a full turn, so its order is 3.

items.prompt: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a square?
hints: A square has four equal corners.
It looks the same after each quarter turn.
Four quarter turns make a full turn.
items.explanation: A square has order 4.

items.prompt: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a rhombus that is not a square?
hints: Turn it a quarter turn. Does it look the same?
It matches after a half turn.
It has two pairs of matching corners.
items.explanation: A rhombus looks the same after a half turn and a full turn, so its order is 2.

items.prompt: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a parallelogram that is not a rectangle?
hints: It has opposite sides equal and parallel.
It matches itself after a half turn.
It does not match after a quarter turn.
items.explanation: A parallelogram has order 2.

items.prompt: What is the order of rotational symmetry of the letter H?
hints: Turn the H upside down.
It looks the same after a half turn.
It does not look the same after a quarter turn.
items.explanation: The letter H looks the same after a half turn, so it has order 2.

items.prompt: What is the order of rotational symmetry of the letter Z?
hints: Turn the Z upside down.
It looks like a Z again after a half turn.
It does not match after a quarter turn.
items.explanation: The letter Z has order 2.

items.prompt: What is the order of rotational symmetry of a plus sign (+) with four equal arms?
hints: Turn it a quarter turn.
It matches every quarter turn.
There are four equal arms.
items.explanation: A plus sign with four equal arms matches 4 times in a full turn, so it has order 4.

items.prompt: Which shape has rotational symmetry of order 3?
hints: Order 3 means it matches 3 times in a full turn.
It is a shape with three equal sides.
Turn it a third of a full turn.
items.explanation: An equilateral triangle matches itself 3 times in a full turn.

items.prompt: Which shape does NOT have rotational symmetry of order 2 or more?

options.text: an isosceles triangle that is not equilateral

hints: It has to look the same before a full turn.
Turn the triangle upside down.
It will not match.
items.explanation: A non-equilateral isosceles triangle only looks the same after a full turn, so it has order 1.

items.prompt: A shape looks the same only after a full turn. What is its order of rotational symmetry?

options.why: It would look the same after a half turn.

hints: The full turn counts as one.
It has no other matching positions.
This means no rotational symmetry.
items.explanation: A shape that only matches after a full turn has order 1, which means no rotational symmetry.

items.prompt: A shape looks the same after a quarter turn. What is the order of rotational symmetry?

options.why: Order 1 means a full turn only.

hints: A quarter turn is 90 degrees.
How many quarter turns in a full turn?
Four.
items.explanation: If it matches after each quarter turn, it matches 4 times in a full turn, so its order is 4.

items.prompt: Which of these letters has rotational symmetry of order 2?
hints: Turn the letter upside down.
It must look the same after a half turn.
Some letters look different upside down.
items.explanation: N looks the same after a half turn, so it has order 2.

items.prompt: Which of these have rotational symmetry of order 2?

options.text: a rectangle that is not a square

hints: Turn each one a half turn.
It must look exactly the same.
A kite does not.
items.explanation: The letter H and a non-square rectangle both match after a half turn.

items.prompt: Sort each shape by its order of rotational symmetry.
hints: Order 1 means no rotational symmetry.
Order 2 matches after a half turn.
Triangle has 3, square has 4.
items.explanation: A kite and F have order 1, a rectangle and H have order 2, and a triangle and square have orders 3 and 4.

items.prompt: A shape has rotational symmetry of order 4. How many degrees do you turn it to reach the first matching position?
hints: A full turn is 360 degrees.
Divide 360 by the order.
items.explanation: 360 ÷ 4 = 90, so it matches after each 90 degree turn.

items.prompt: A shape has rotational symmetry of order 3. How many degrees do you turn it to reach the first matching position?
hints: A full turn is 360 degrees.
Divide 360 by the order.
items.explanation: 360 ÷ 3 = 120, so it matches after each 120 degree turn.

items.prompt: A shape matches itself after each turn of 180 degrees. What is its order of rotational symmetry?
hints: Divide 360 by the matching turn.
A half turn gives two matches in a full turn.
items.explanation: 360 ÷ 180 = 2, so the order is 2.

items.prompt: A square is rotated by 45 degrees. Does it look the same?

options.text: Yes, it looks the same after any turn.
No, a square only matches after turns of 90 degrees.
Yes, because a square has order 8.

hints: A square has order 4.
45 is not a multiple of 90.
items.explanation: A square matches itself after turns of 90 degrees, so 45 degrees does not match.

items.prompt: Which statement is true about an equilateral triangle?

options.text: It looks the same after a turn of 90 degrees.
It looks the same after a turn of 120 degrees.
It looks the same after a turn of 180 degrees.

hints: The triangle has three equal corners.
It matches 3 times in a full turn.
items.explanation: An equilateral triangle has order 3, so it matches after each 120 degree turn.

items.prompt: A pinwheel has 4 identical blades equally spaced. What is its order of rotational symmetry?

options.why: Four identical blades give four matching positions.

hints: Count the identical blades.
Turn it through the angle between blades.
The turn between blades is 90 degrees.
items.explanation: With 4 identical blades equally spaced, the pinwheel matches 4 times in a full turn, so its order is 4.

items.prompt: A logo has 3 identical petals equally spaced. What is the smallest turn that makes the logo look the same?
hints: Divide a full turn between the petals.
The turn is the same between each pair of petals.
items.explanation: 360 ÷ 3 = 120 degrees.

items.prompt: Which shape has the same order of rotational symmetry as the letter H?

options.text: a rectangle that is not a square

hints: H has order 2.
Look for a shape that matches after a half turn.
It has opposite sides equal.
items.explanation: Both the letter H and a non-square rectangle have order 2.

items.prompt: A shape that looks the same after a half turn has rotational symmetry of order ___.
hints: A half turn is 180 degrees.
It matches two times in a full turn.
items.explanation: A half-turn match means order 2.
